entries.speaker: Accosting Office Worker
entries.en: You're running this place like nothing[n]happened! Didn't you find out what[n]caused the accident!?

entries.speaker: Bewildered Station Attendant
entries.en: The police are investigating the cause[n]right now. We're working hard to ensure[n]your safety...

entries.speaker: Accosting Office Worker
entries.en: There was a bus accident before,[n]just like this! Didn't you figure out[n]how to prevent this already!?

entries.speaker: Bewildered Station Attendant
entries.en: I'm very sorry, sir. It seems the conductor[n]suddenly fell unconscious, and then...

entries.speaker: Accosting Office Worker
entries.en: You don't get it! Our lives are[n]in danger here!

entries.speaker: Bewildered Station Attendant
entries.en: I apologize, sir. We're carrying out[n]thorough safety inspections to make[n]sure that it's safe...

entries.speaker: Tired-Looking Office Worker
entries.en: How can you think it's all a coincidence[n]if the same thing keeps happening, again[n]and again?

entries.speaker: Office Worker Heading Home
entries.en: The train derailing the other day was[n]horrific. If you ask me, it looked like[n]an act of terrorism.

entries.speaker: Tired-Looking Office Worker
entries.en: Maybe it's a conspiracy, another[n]country attacking us. You think[n]they're using mind control?

entries.speaker: Office Worker Heading Home
entries.en: If it was mind control, they're messing[n]it up. Those people end up going brain[n]dead, don't they?

entries.speaker: Tired-Looking Office Worker
entries.en: I wonder if this'll happen again soon.[n]When did people start having those[n]psychotic breakdowns?

entries.speaker: Office Worker Heading Home
entries.en: Since last year, I think. Someone needs to[n]put a stop to this. I don't care who does it.
